value.text: Independent focused repair: LCOV invalidates before configuration parsing and on runner or inventory failure. Three real filesystem assertions fail with original source and pass after byte-identical restoration. Actual existing YAML verifier accepts real scalar and array dependency fixtures and rejects seven workflow or marker drifts. Full native suite now passes 301 tests with unchanged thresholds. Broader pre-repair c8 observation reached 3837/3837 statements and lines, 1177/1178 branches and 102/102 reported functions across ten TS/JS executables; one non-Error conversion branch, shell coverage and zero function counters for two operational scripts remain explicit. Whole AST presence inventory includes 247 callables (57 with JSDoc) and 809 declaration/type nodes (115 with JSDoc); these are presence counts, not high-quality documentation approval. Closed helper owner pm-context-qu0a remains held by codex; managed launcher callback remains undocumented under its byte-identical template contract. No source is excluded or renamed to claim whole-source completion.
